name: sleuthkit/sleuthkit
description: A library and collection of command-line forensic tools for investigating volume and file system data, supporting NTFS, FAT, Ext, HFS, and other file systems. Serves as the foundation for Autopsy and other commercial/open-source forensic platforms.
score_rationale: Foundational open-source forensic toolkit with 3k stars and active 2025 releases, underpinning both open-source and commercial digital forensics tools globally.
